capabilities.description: `debug` unlocks the debug methods on a build that has them.

What the host lets the core do, such as `tun.inherited`. Clients test
these, never the operating system name.

faults.description: Requested services that did not start, as of the last apply, patch, start or stop.

Empty.description: The result of a method that has nothing to report.

code.description: A stable identifier, such as `unknown_key`, for clients that word the warning themselves.

profile.description: Absent applies the `config.yaml` already in the home directory.

overlay.description:
The profile gives only `proxies`, `proxy-groups`, `sub-rules` and `rules`; every other
key, the listeners included, comes from here. Rules listed here go before the profile's.

ProfileRef.description: A file inside the core's home directory.

testUrl.description: An empty value keeps the URL in force.

delayTestTimeout.description: Milliseconds; zero keeps the timeout in force.

bindAddress.description: `*` binds every address; read only while the LAN is allowed.

lanAllowedIps.description: CIDR prefixes admitted to the mixed, HTTP and SOCKS listeners.

lanDisallowedIps.description: CIDR prefixes refused there even when the allowed list admits them.

ConfigPatchParams.description: An absent field keeps the value in force.

ControllerCorsPatch.description:
Which browser origins may call the external controller. An absent field takes mihomo's
default: every origin, and private-network preflights allowed. No origin refuses them all.

ChangeSeq.description: The order of a change among all changes of state a host keeps.

selections.description: The pick of each group that has one.

GeneralState.description:
The general settings in force. `seq` is the last change reflected here and
in `selections`, so `events.watch` with `state` continues after it.

Output.description:
Where a large result goes: back in the response, or into a file the caller
names inside the home directory.

size.description: Bytes written, for a file output.
Bytes written, for a file output.

ProxyGroups.description:
Group names in display order with `GLOBAL` first, the groups, and every
node a group can name.

now.description: Absent for load balancing, which has no single current member.

credit.description: Batches the server may send before the next `$/credit`. Default 4.

maxBatchMs.description: How long a batch may collect events. Default 16.

maxBatchBytes.description: Size at which a batch is sent at once. Default 51200.

ProxyWatchParams.description: Options every stream method accepts beside its own parameters.

ProxyDelta.description:
What changed since the last batch of this subscription. A group or node is
sent whole; `removed` names those that are gone.

proxy.description: An empty name clears the pick.

seq.description: The change this select made, or the last change when it made none.

names.description: Absent lists every name `proxy.groups` lists; unknown names are left out.

ProxyState.description: The last ten results, overall and for each URL a node was tested at.

DelayRecord.description: `time` is Unix milliseconds; `delay` 0 is a failed test.

expected.description: Status ranges such as `200/204/300-399` that count as a success. Default any.

DelayResult.description: `value` is milliseconds when positive, -1 for a timeout and -2 for a failure.

concurrency.description: Tests running at once. Default: every proxy at once, as the Clash API tests a group.

credit.description: Batches the server may send before the next `$/credit`. Default 4.

maxBatchMs.description: How long a batch may collect events. Default 16.

maxBatchBytes.description: Size at which a batch is sent at once. Default 51200.

DelayRunParams.description: Options every stream method accepts beside its own parameters.

DelayRunEvent.description: One entry of `delay.run`: a result for each proxy, then `done`.

results.description: One entry per input line, empty when the line is not a link.

updatedAt.description: Absent while the provider has never loaded.

testUrl.description: Proxy providers: the health check's URL and expected statuses.

RuleEntry.description: One rule of the main list in force, in match order.

url.description: Empty compiles the file already stored under that name.

credit.description: Batches the server may send before the next `$/credit`. Default 4.

maxBatchMs.description: How long a batch may collect events. Default 16.

maxBatchBytes.description: Size at which a batch is sent at once. Default 51200.

TrafficWatchParams.description: Options every stream method accepts beside its own parameters.

Traffic.description: Rates are bytes per second; totals count from the last `traffic.reset`.

counters.description:
Send `counters` in the deltas. Default true; a client that shows no
traffic figures turns them off and the stream carries only opens and
closes.

credit.description: Batches the server may send before the next `$/credit`. Default 4.

maxBatchMs.description: How long a batch may collect events. Default 16.

maxBatchBytes.description: Size at which a batch is sent at once. Default 51200.

ConnectionWatchParams.description: Options every stream method accepts beside its own parameters.

sniffHost.description: The host the sniffer read from the traffic.

inboundType.description: The kind of inbound that accepted the connection, such as `socks5` or `tun`.

ConnectionDelta.description:
An `opened` entry that a client already has is a repeat and replaces it.
A connection that opened and closed between two batches is in both lists,
so apply `opened` first and `closed` after.

dnsServers.description: Socket addresses of the resolvers the system now uses.

interfaceChanged.description: The default network changed: connections over the old one are closed.

qtype.description: A record type such as `A` or `AAAA`. Default `A`.

DnsRecord.description: `data` is the record's data in presentation format.

level.description: Entries below this level are left out of this subscription.

maxBatchMs.description: How long a batch may collect events. Default 16.

maxBatchBytes.description: Size at which a batch is sent at once. Default 51200.

LogWatchParams.description: Options every stream method accepts beside its own parameters.

credit.description: Batches the server may send before the next `$/credit`. Default 4.

maxBatchMs.description: How long a batch may collect events. Default 16.

maxBatchBytes.description: Size at which a batch is sent at once. Default 51200.

DnsWatchParams.description: Options every stream method accepts beside its own parameters.

credit.description: Batches the server may send before the next `$/credit`. Default 4.

maxBatchMs.description: How long a batch may collect events. Default 16.

maxBatchBytes.description: Size at which a batch is sent at once. Default 51200.

RouteWatchParams.description: Options every stream method accepts beside its own parameters.

running.description: Whether the listeners were running when `epoch` last moved.

delays.description: Also report every URL test result, the automatic ones of the groups included.

state.description:
Also report `stateChanged`: every change of a pick or of the general
settings a host keeps, from any origin, in the order it took effect.

credit.description: Batches the server may send before the next `$/credit`. Default 4.

maxBatchMs.description: How long a batch may collect events. Default 16.

maxBatchBytes.description: Size at which a batch is sent at once. Default 51200.

EventsWatchParams.description: Options every stream method accepts beside its own parameters.

oneOf.description:
One step of a fetch of a provider or a geo database, whatever started
it: its first load, a retry, its interval, its file changing, or a
caller. A geo database is named `MMDB`, `ASN` or `GEOSITE`, as
`geo.update` names it. Every step of a provider's first load waits
until the `config.apply` that made it has finished. A fetch cut short by
a newer apply or by shutdown ends `failed` with the error `superseded`.
Sent only to a watch that asked for `state`.
Fetched, and the same as the content in force.
A fallback group dropped a pick whose node died.
A config apply replaced the picks with the ones it was given.

GeneralChange.description: The fields of a general patch that changed, with their new values.

credit.description: Batches the server may send before the next `$/credit`. Default 4.

maxBatchMs.description: How long a batch may collect events. Default 16.

maxBatchBytes.description: Size at which a batch is sent at once. Default 51200.

EngineStateParams.description: Options every stream method accepts beside its own parameters.

TunSource.description:
A device the core creates itself, or a descriptor the host opened and
registered beforehand.

RouteCheckResult.description:
`held[i]` says route `i` still leaves where it did; `epoch` and `version`
are the stamp the answers were checked against.

certificate.description: Absent while no certificate authority exists.

MitmValidateResult.description:
Both keyed by list, as the section names it (`hostname`, `url-rewrite`, ...), in
line order. A line in force has a view; one that cannot be read has an issue; a
`hostname` or `client-source-address` line some of whose items apply has both.

MitmIssue.description:
A line of a list that cannot be read, or of whose items some cannot. `index` is
the line's place in its list, blank lines and comments counted.

requestHead.description: The request-head pattern of Quantumult X's `url-and-header`.

name.description: In canonical case; absent for `header-text-replace`, which rewrites the whole head.

jq.description: The expression as compiled, without the quotes around it.

MitmDataType.description: A line without `data-type` reads a file.

data.description: The `data` parameter as written: a file name, text or base64; empty for `tiny-gif`.

status.description: Present for `map-local` only, 200 unless the line sets it.

name.description: The name `mitm.runScript` takes; the file name when the line gives none.

timeoutMs.description: The timeout in force, capped as the core caps it.

host.description: Lower case, without a trailing dot or IPv6 brackets; may hold `*` and `?`.

port.description: Absent when the entry names none, which covers 443 and 80.

MitmHosts.description: The entries of a line in force, without those that could not be read.

network.description: A CIDR; a single address has its full prefix length.

MitmSources.description: The entries of a line in force: those before the first that could not be read.

connection.description:
A connection id from `connection.watch`, open or closed since, as long as
the capture still holds its exchanges.

reason.description: A stable subcode, such as `rule_set_empty`, for clients that word the failure themselves.

ErrorData.description: The stable part of an error. Clients branch on `kind`; `message` is for people.
